notes.title: build 383 (18.07.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes:
Added gamepad text input support when playing in Steam Big Picture mode
 Fixed some gamepad navigation issues in level editor
 Fixed touchscreen camera controls not working when playing workshop levels
 Fixed some touchscreen buttons not working in regular mode

notes.title: build 377 (22.06.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes: Fixed final split not triggering when using LiveSplit.Server in time attack mode

notes.title: build 375 (06.06.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes:
Added preliminary support for LiveSplit.Server
 Made 40 km/h running task easier

Scripting API:
 Renamed LevelManager.Playing to LevelManager.TimerRunning
 Renamed LevelManager.Unpause() to LevelManager.StartTimer()
 Renamed LevelManager.Pause() to LevelManager.StopTimer()

notes.title: build 374 (31.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes: Reordered some tasks in an effort to make difficulty curve smoother

notes.title: build 373 (30.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes:
Added replay recording support for workshop levels
 Added a reference to Unity.TextMeshPro.dll for scripting
 Fixed invalid script execution order when playing workshop levels outside of editor
 Fixed CanvasScaler component not saving in editor
 Fixed error when toggling Behaviour.enabled property in editor in some cases

notes.title: build 372 (29.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes:
Fixed quick restart not working after first restart in workshop levels
 Fixed console error when saving a scene in editor 
 Fixed leaderboard scores displaying incorrectly in workshop levels

notes.title: build 371 (29.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes:
Added Simplified Chinese language
 Added Traditional Chinese language
 Added Dutch language
 Added Turkish language
 Added Ukrainian language
 Fixed "StorageException: Value RuntimeTypeGuids.txt was not found" error when compiling scripts in editor
 Fixed invalid .csproj file generation

notes.title: build 370 (27.05.2023) - patch notes
notes.notes: Fixed black bars in some areas of the game when playing on a wide screen monitor
